_notes: This profile is intentionally uncalibrated. Run scripts/inspect_busy_ui.py with BUSY 21 open in H.S. Traders, navigate to the Sales Register manually, and copy the observed control selectors here.
navigation_keys is a list of pywinauto key sequences. Example: ["{ALT}m", "r", "s"].
A control selector is an object such as {"class_name": "Edit", "control_id": 1234} or {"title": "From"}.
format_keys must select Excel if BUSY defaults to another export format. confirm_keys must trigger the export (Enter, F2, or a calibrated key sequence).
open_after_keys defaults to "n"; use "%n" (Alt+N) or another calibrated sequence if BUSY shows a standard Windows message box.
If BUSY opens report windows as separate top-level windows, add their title regexes to allowed_dialog_title_res and set allowed_dialog_dismiss_keys to "{ESC}".
The pipeline refuses to run until sales_register.navigation_keys and the date fields are calibrated.
